_info.description: FED-HPC offline scheduling instance — pos_congestion_20240130 case study (2024-01-30 20:00–24:00 UTC, pos/CSR1 congestion event). exec_time = actual elapsed / slot_size_seconds (known runtimes). Time slot = elapsed time of the smallest job in the dataset. Built by scripts/build_pos_congestion_instance.py — a standalone converter reading window_jobs/initial_state_jobs directly (NOT the live overseer simulator); see that script's docstring for the reverse-engineered generation rules and their limitations (no per-job partition restriction).
